records.english: Sorry, but that won't be enough. Come back when you've earned more.{PAD}
records.speaker: Trader
records.context: The trader rejects an investment that is below the required amount.
records.source_meaning: The trader apologizes, says the amount cannot accomplish anything, and tells the player to earn more before returning.
records.localization_note: Keeps the refusal firm but conversational.

records.english: We might get more if we pay double.{PAD}
records.speaker: Companion
records.context: Another companion voice explains the temporary double-price stock offer.
records.source_meaning: The companion says paying twice the normal amount now may allow more of certain goods to be purchased.
records.localization_note: Keeps the rougher voice direct while preserving the mechanic.
